scenes.title: PML Electron-Microscope Inspection Bay
scenes.institution: Boston University Photonics Center — Precision Measurement Laboratory SEM bay
scenes.reference_notes: Official PML operator photograph inspected at full available resolution: installed field-emission microscope with large vented upper casing, multiport lower specimen chamber and a three-monitor console. Page lists Zeiss Supra systems, but the photographed model suffix is not legible. Photo supports only one SEM bay; exact Supra model and hidden chamber internals unverified. Operators partially occlude the lower access region. No electron optics or imaging solver; neighboring PML rooms must not be merged. A public UT Dallas Supra40 operating description supports the generic door-carried specimen-stage concept, not the exact BU model or dimensions. Current BU SOP links require community access; those restricted documents were not read. Manufacturer-authored Supra-family references hosted by NTNU and Parma supply the nominal 330 mm by 270 mm chamber and stage travel; this does not identify the installed BU model. Revision 3 uses authored compact telescopes and supported crossed slides rather than the former projecting external rail deck. The optional fixed exterior detail revision adds source-visible inclined detector/manifold and cabinet/column features with estimated supports; it does not establish exact OEM correspondence. Source context revision 1 adds the photographed parked blue seats, populated console, small controllers, mice, connected fixed leads and upper chamber ports. The blue wall chart and monitor panes are original schematics, not copied poster artwork or simulated SEM measurements. Unseen chair frames, service routes, component dimensions and room depth are estimated.

Curved multi-knob console and three-monitor station immediately adjacent to the microscope.

Plan gives room 520 area of 1006 square feet, but no surveyed edge lengths; apparatus dimensions and optical response unverified.
